entities.summary: Arto Sakari Ruotanen is a retired professional ice hockey defenceman who played in the SM-liiga. He played for Kärpät. He was inducted into the Finnish Hockey Hall of Fame in 2003. He is 5 ft 11 in (180 cm) tall and nicknamed 'Artsi'.
